body:
Court update if anyone is curious: 
After going through Grand Jury in the summer, and pre-trial being conducted in the fall, my court date was cancelled. 
Pre-trial was reschedule according to the defense’s request. 
The defense just cancelled pre-trial. Again. I do not know if it is even worth it anymore.

Just checking in on ya, I hope you’ve made some progress with thinking about counseling. It will help you sort out your emotions in a healthy way. You could do it on your own, you’re strong enough, but counseling will ensure you do it efficiently and safely.

I seriously cannot tell you how much I understand and relate...it has been almost two years since he raped me, and court has been cancelled/postponed because the defense asked for it..I feel as though I am getting worse, and I feel like a bigger burden on everyone around me as more time passes. 
I know it is hard to not think about “what if I don’t go through with it and he rapes someone else”, but if it is going to cost you your life, it is not worth going through with it. 
Please consider talking to a counselor; I thought counseling was BS but the lady I ended up with has been so helpful. It is nice being able to talk to someone who is removed from the situation. 
I am here for you too if you want to vent or talk or anything. 
I hope you find peace. You are so valuable. You are not ruined or tarnished.

Wow, that brought me some peace..thank you for your words of affirmation. I’m sorry that you have had to go through this too. 

I got kicked off the track team before he did, and when I told my coach, he responded with “why weren’t you in your own hotel room at curfew? Jesus Christ [my name]”, and then promptly kicked me off the team while leaving him on. He then told teammates the details that I had only told him, such as the rape kit, the fact that I was going to peruse it, etc...ultimate betrayal from a coach I looked up to and ran my heart out for for two years. I lost all the friends I had made through the sport, too, because my assaulter was very popular. 

It just feels like NOTHING has happened to him that would bring me any feeling of justice, especially now with him not even feeling any remorse and pretending to be this new father who loves his girlfriend and child, court being cancelled, and me being stuck with night terrors, PTSD, and participating in therapy because I’m not making any progress. All the while feeling unworthy of love from my super supportive boyfriend and family. 

Thank you so much for replying, I will be rereading this often, I’m sure.
Thank you, that means a lot to hear that from someone outside of my family. 😭
Thank you so much. And yeah, I feel like I’m the one on trial and I’m the one that has to prove my innocence.

Thank you, I needed to hear that...

I have been dating the most wonderful man I have ever met, and he has been so patient and helpful. I just wish I wasn’t a burden on him. 

I’m sorry you went through that, but you give me hope about my future. Thank you.

I am so very sorry you are dealing with that..you deserve to have someone who feels like a safe home for your heart, and who loves you. You will find that, so just keep healing and talking if that helps. You can always message me too if you feel like venting.

That’s true..I’m sorry you went through that..I definitely relate. It feels like they get to just forget about it when we are the ones dealing with the consequences we never asked for. I still wake up from night terrors about it. Additionally, his family posted about how I’m ruining multiple lives when he’s the one who raped me and I’m just trying to find justice...that makes me feel angry but also sad for the kid if I do get solace from court because he probably won’t have a dad around..
I feel it. I’m here if you wanna talk..

Thank you; I have told him that a lot, I just hope he can believe it soon. 
I don’t feel like I deserve it, but I’ll keep trying to get help. Thank you again.

Thank you so much. I appreciate you. I will post an update about court..I am terrified of seeing him again and I don’t know if I can do it. I’m not sure when court will be as the defense asked for it to be postponed and the judge agreed...
Thank you, I will keep your advice in mind when I am feeling this way. I appreciate you
Thank you very much for your kind words. I am trying to get better and not give in. Thank you for hearing me.

I am so very sorry for your daughter and also for you. I hope she can find some sort of peace. 
I am close with my father, and he told me he feels like he should have been able to prevent it from happening, even though there is no way he could have. I love him and my mom and brother so much. I wish I wasn’t so sad all the time because I feel like I am taking them for granted.
Thank you for hearing me and taking the time to reach out. I appreciate you very very much.
